title: Hold
body:
Syntax: hold <item>

Description: Equips a tool -- a fishing rod, pickaxe, axe, hoe, or cooking pot -- in its own slot, separate from your wielded weapon and worn armor, so you can hold a tool and still fight with your weapon equipped. Only accepts an actual tool -- armor or a weapon is refused here (see 'wear'/'wield' instead).

Date: 2026-08-17
